title: Reignclipse prints one Armor and one Burns line
notes: Reignclipse (S+ #133.5) printed Reign's and Eclipse's lines side by side: Armor 4 and Armor 3 (Radiant 4 and 6) and two Burns lines of 4 and 5 (8 and 10). It now prints what it played (R3565003): Armor 7 (Radiant 10) and one Damage also Burns 9 (Radiant 18). Its display-only damage number is gone, so a Buff or a Nerf that tunes it always moves the Burn.

player.title: Reignclipse reads as it plays
text: Reignclipse now prints its two Armors as one, Armor 7 (Radiant 10), and its two Burns lines as one, Damage also Burns 9 (Radiant 18). It plays the same.
fixes: A Buff or a Nerf on Reignclipse always changes its Burn now; one of its numbers did nothing.
